description: SMARD is the electricity market data platform of Germany's Federal Network Agency (Bundesnetzagentur), which publishes data on the German power system . Market data for Germany cover generation and consumption, wholesale electricity prices and commercial cross-border exchanges, balancing control reserve, renewable generation and consumption, and forecasted generation and consumption, shown as interactive visuals. A separate section gives time series of generation from individual units with at least 100 MW of installed capacity. The data are reported by the German transmission system operators under EU Regulation 543/2013, the same basis as the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform, at quarter-hour resolution from 2015 onward, and third-party copies on IEEE DataPort repackage the German and Luxembourg generation series. The site also publishes articles on congestion management, battery storage applications, quarterly market reviews and disconnection statistics. Coverage is Germany. Data are downloadable free of charge from the download centre under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: generation excludes industrial networks, closed distribution networks and the railway network. Simulation uses are dispatch, market and grid studies of the German system, and tracking events such as congestion measures.
